name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      comment:
        description: 'Optional comment for the merge commit'
        required: false
        default: ''

jobs:
  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs
        run: |
          git fetch origin dev
          git checkout features/hubs-recs
          git merge --no-ff dev -m "Merge dev into features/hubs-recs${{ github.event.inputs.comment && ' - ' || '' }}${{ github.event.inputs.comment }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Push changes
        run: |
          git push origin features/hubs-recs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Verify build
        run: |
